# Serai

> Serai is a word-search game for learning vocabulary on iPhone. The player reads a word in their own language and finds its translation on a fully tiled board of letters by swiping through it; words snake around corners and every letter belongs to exactly one word.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 15 or later. Coming soon to the App Store.
- Languages (learn from any into any other; app interface in the same languages): English, German, Russian, French, Kazakh, Czech, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified, with pinyin), Korean, Italian, Mongolian, Turkish, Japanese (played in kana; after a find the word is shown with its kanji), Portuguese (Brazilian) and Ukrainian.
- Content: about 8,000 words, CEFR levels A1 to C2, grouped into everyday topics; placement test; spaced review; a Daily Hunt board that is the same for everyone each day.
- Name: a serai (caravanserai) was a walled inn on the Silk Road where traders from many lands rested and swapped words; in the app every board is a stop on that road, and the level path runs from The First Serai (A1) to The Keeper's Hall (C2).
- Progress: six level badges (Wayfarer, Trader, Caravaneer, Interpreter, Envoy, Keeper of the Serai), also Game Center achievements.
- Price: free to download, all languages and levels included, no ads, no subscription.
- Expeditions (optional one-time in-app purchases, shared with Family Sharing; names are translated in the app):
  - "The Taklamakan Crossing" (€9.99): description clues, a short description in your language instead of the translation, on every topic you have cleared; bonus XP and coins.
  - "The Jade Gate": opposite boards, every clue is the opposite of the word to find, in the language you are learning (e.g. "opposite of cold" → HOT); words from every level you have reached. Price not announced yet.
  - "The Pamir Pass" (€4.99): word ladders, five words in the language you are learning, each one letter different from the next (e.g. BOOT → FOOT → FOOD → MOOD → MOON); spell each word from its clue, put the words in order, then finish the top and bottom word. A daily climb (the same ladder for everyone learning the language) plus climbs at your level.
  - "The Mogao Cave" (€4.99): flashcards. A card shows the word in your language with its topic and level; you think of the word in the language you are learning, turn the card, see it spelled in tiles and hear it, then tap "Not yet" or "Knew it". Answers feed the same spaced review schedule as the boards. A daily deck of 20 cards (listed in Today), plus decks of your due words, of any topic you have started and of your trickiest words. Cards do not advance the level path; the boards stay free and remain the heart of the game. Named after the Mogao Caves near Dunhuang, close to the Jade Gate, where a sealed library cave held about 50,000 manuscripts in many scripts.
- Privacy: no account, works offline, progress stays on the device, no personal data collected, no tracking.
- Developer: Christian Heuer, Zollikon, Switzerland. Contact: chris@getserai.app
